question: In a separation by high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) with elution with gradients:

options.opa: The composition of the mobile phase varies throughout the chromatography.
options.opb: The temperature of the mobile phase varies throughout the chromatography.
options.opc: The pressure of the mobile phase varies throughout the chromatography.
options.opd: The composition, temperature and pressure of the mobile phase are constant throughout the chromatography.
